main_body: Wooden display counter (rows 22-31) with a glass dome over a tiered cake (rows 10-22)
top_band: Counter top is only about 1-2 rows: an orange row at 22 and a dark row at 23. The cream plate strip at row 21 is just the cake base. No real top surface.
evidence: Reading down the middle column: a pale blue glass dome with a white highlight, then the cake layers seen straight on, then a cream plate row, an orange 1-row rim, a dark row, and a brown front face with inset drawer or panel recesses. The base reads as a front view with only a thin rim, so no horizontal surface is visible from above. The dome and cake are also drawn in elevation. The piece is a low counter, not tall furniture, so the kind is a poor match.

style.evidence: The glass is mostly one flat light blue with a few highlight pixels. The wood has about 3 tones and large flat brown panels, with no grain or per-plank texture. The cake layers are small flat bands. The base has a dark brown outline, but the dome has almost none. Next to the stall and well references, which have 5-6 steps and dense texture, each tile carries only about 3-5 colours.
